set.body:
Type: acceptance gate
Work key: H05
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Product/frontend lead
Scope: Routine repository work must be complete through supported screens and recoverable operations.

Work kind: acceptance-gate
Suggested delivery tranche: T5; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A curator creates and ingests into an authorized project, inspects findings, proposes/reviews/accepts a correction and handles interrupted work without ad hoc database intervention.
2. A researcher discovers permitted data, retrieves exact old/new releases through verified exports, and shares/revokes the agreed historical scope; retry/cancel/expiry and conflict states never masquerade as completed work.
3. Assignments, notes, activity and quality review bind exact releases and current permissions; the local guided journey uses real supported screens, with human accessibility and institutional adoption still separately open.

Expected review receipt: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H05/receipt.json

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/institutional-readiness-backlog.json

Blocked by:
- W01: bd-01M4W40KKEG53SX6WJ17NQVQSV
- W02: bd-01M4W40KPVEFQSMWFEDZZC69SW
- L01.4: bd-01M4X5MABQ32PFAAKMZQ4FJKNG

Review existing implementation receipts against this cross-cutting area. Do not duplicate or reparent their tasks. Close only with observed evidence; planning and previous unrelated tests are insufficient.

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H05: Review core: Complete everyday repository workflows
